# Blades of Ages

> Blades of Ages is a one-thumb action game in which outward-facing blades spin around your hero. Cut through waves of monsters and defeat bosses across 5 ages and 12 mythological realms.

Status: not yet released (coming soon to the App Store). Platforms: iPhone, iPad.
Turkish name: Çağların Kılıcı. Developer: Mehmet Mutlu (https://mm-apps.com/).

## Facts
- Ages: 5; mythological realms: 12; maps: 120 (10 per realm); heroes: 21
- Controls: one thumb. Walking widens the blades' orbit; standing still draws them in and spins them faster.
- Monetization: free to download, optional in-app purchases, no forced ads; rewarded ads only by choice.
- Game languages: Turkish, English, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, German, French

## Ages and realms
- First Age (Stone and Bronze · 9600–2000 BC): Göbekli Tepe, Sumer
- Ancient Age (Bronze and Iron · 2000–300 BC): Egypt, Greece, Hatti
- North and Steppe (Early Middle Ages · 500–1100): Scandinavia, Turkic-Altai, Celtic Lands
- East and New World (Late Middle Ages · 1100–1500): Japan, China, Mesoamerica
- Lost Age (Timeless): Silik
